name: harness-audit
description: Audit any repo's agent harness against four pillars and emit an executable rubric a loop can converge against, then ships the six loops that converge against it (stateless verification, skill learning, multi-agent review, deep verification, workflow improvement, operator session review) plus /dashboard-harness, a zero-token auditor of tool failures, guards, skills installed against skills used, session hygiene and the /session-review lifecycle, read from the local transcripts and never leaving the machine. Ships write-time security guards (destructive-command gate, secret scan, no-verify block) and a loop-hygiene guard (repeat-tool-guard: an advisory reminder after consecutive identical tool calls).
